scope: Bihar local seats, reservations, candidates and winners. Affidavits are separate and unchanged.

2011_reports.collected: Historical handoff; original download dates unknown
2011_reports.purpose: 23 district winner PDFs, Gaya winner workbook and runner-up PDF. Originals retain all pages and rows.

2016_pages.collected: September 2026; exact request dates in ledgers
2016_pages.purpose: Geography form responses and election results; request metadata and original response bodies travel together.

2021_pages.collected: September 2026; exact request dates in ledgers
2021_pages.purpose: General and by-election geography, candidates, results, phases and current-term feeds.

2021_geography_and_mukhiya_snapshot.collected: September 2026; exact request dates in ledgers
2021_geography_and_mukhiya_snapshot.purpose: District/block names and current-term Mukhiya winners and reservations.

project_deposit.contents: Three required-source archives, sixteen Parquets and the code/documentation archive. Zenodo Parquet filenames replace / in each output path with __.

historical_2016.verification: On 2026-10-01 API sizes and MD5s matched the local export; manifest downloaded and byte-matched. Remaining payloads not re-downloaded.
historical_2016.layout: 48 rp chunks plus frame-page and reservation-roster tar archives, three Parquets and documentation. Preserved as its own historical deposit.

2011_year.evidence: Gaya workbook states 2011. User identified primary/alternate winner PDFs and companion runner lists as 2011; prior-elected-office columns concern 2001/2006. This is collection identification, not a printed date verified on every PDF page.

interpretation.2011_overlap: District winner table contains all 338 Gaya primary PDF winners. Gaya workbook and runner-up lists remain separate source claims. Name differences have not been established as conflicts. Court transcription overlaps one district winner; counts are not additive.
interpretation.runner_seat_links: GP inferred from complete serial, block and exact reservation alignment of companion reports, corroborated by 25 block-first GP headings. Row-level linkage evidence is in runner_up_records.parquet.
interpretation.2021_term: 2021 election, 2023/2025 by-elections and undated current-term feeds stay separate. Current reservations and occupants are not assigned retrospectively. Election-specific reservation linkage is incomplete.
interpretation.cross_year: Matching codes or labels do not establish stable seat boundaries across general elections.

gaps.saved_pages: Missing or incomplete saved responses are collection gaps, not a request to scrape again. The 2021 tables preserve available observations and response-status fields. The 2016 parser requires --partial to parse an incomplete results capture. Missing geography can prevent frame reconstruction.
gaps.original_documents: Preserve complete source PDFs and workbooks, including unparsed pages and rejected records. Dataset manifests carry document checksums.
gaps.historical_dates: 32 other-office workbooks have 2006 headings; 37 Mukhiya and 35 Sarpanch workbooks remain undated.

search_findings.dataverse:
On October 1, 2026, an authenticated Harvard Dataverse search covered all 83
datasets accessible to `@soodoku`, including drafts, and public Bihar/project
filename searches. No Bihar local-election deposit was found within that scope.
[PRI Seat Reservation Data](https://doi.org/10.7910/DVN/PQZVCO) contained
`haryana_mau_1995_2021.gz`. This cannot rule out deleted uploads, other accounts
or unrelated filenames.
search_findings.sec_archive:
The [SEC archive](https://sec.bihar.gov.in/archive) labels its older candidate,
vote and winner forms as 2016. A five-request check of its
[winner form](https://sec.bihar.gov.in/old-sec/wcl.aspx) returned 12 Mukhiya
winner names for Arwal block, Arwal district, matching the published name set.
This was not a seat-key comparison or a statewide completeness check.
No verified 2011 candidate-results endpoint was found in the inspected pages
and targeted searches; that is not proof that none exists.

retention.raw: Only originals used by the listed pipelines. Include the original response body together with its URL, parameters and collection date.
retention.unprocessed: Unique collected originals with no current output are in one unprocessed/<year>/ collection outside data/<year>/raw and the reproduction archives; optionally expose it at data/unprocessed for audit commands.
retention.cache: Geography frames and other generated intermediate files belong in .cache; remove after use if desired.
retention.affidavits: Existing affidavit sources and review inputs remain unchanged, outside these pipelines.
retention.metadata: Dataset MANIFEST.json files own schemas and source/output checksums. This file owns collection origins and pipeline definitions.
